name: RescueTime
description_en:
RescueTime tracks computer app/website activity in the background and turns it into personal/team focus reports. Focus tools include goals and blocking, while the Timesheets bundle adds project-oriented time allocation.

A history of apps used is not automatically a correct billable timesheet. The current product explicitly says it does not collect keystrokes, form input, screenshots or webpage content; this boundary differs from screenshot-monitoring products.
description_zh:
RescueTime 在后台追踪电脑应用/网站活动，形成个人或团队专注报告。Focus 含目标和阻断工具，Timesheets 组合增加项目时间分配。

应用使用历史不自动成为正确可计费工时表。当前产品明确表示不采集按键、表单输入、截图或网页内容，边界不同于截图监控产品。

core_features.explanation_en: Record app/site time to review focus patterns.
core_features.explanation_zh: 记录应用/网站时间以查看专注模式。

core_features.explanation_en: Focus blocking/goals and bundled project timesheets solve different tasks.
core_features.explanation_zh: 专注阻断/目标和组合项目工时表解决不同任务。

en: Install the computer app and review its captured activity. Categorize a client design session separately from internal learning and add offline work where appropriate. A shared tool used for several clients needs review; the active app alone cannot identify the correct client. Test a focus block against one permitted and one blocked tool. This is suggested evaluation, not an executed workday.
zh: 安装电脑应用并查看采集活动，区分客户设计、内部学习，并适当补线下工作。同一工具用于多客户时需要审查，活动应用本身不能确定正确客户。建议用一个允许和一个被阻断工具测试专注时段。本文未执行工作日测试。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: Solo/Team Focus or plus Timesheets bundle, annual USD totals or monthly billing; post-trial charge applies.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Solo/Team Focus or plus Timesheets bundle, annual USD totals or monthly billing; post-trial charge applies.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Solo/Team Focus 或 Timesheets 加号组合，USD 年付或月付；试用后收费。

official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_zh: 示例：客户分配前审查设计工作日
sections.en: Install the computer app and review its captured activity. Categorize a client design session separately from internal learning and add offline work where appropriate. A shared tool used for several clients needs review; the active app alone cannot identify the correct client. Test a focus block against one permitted and one blocked tool. This is suggested evaluation, not an executed workday.
sections.zh: 安装电脑应用并查看采集活动，区分客户设计、内部学习，并适当补线下工作。同一工具用于多客户时需要审查，活动应用本身不能确定正确客户。建议用一个允许和一个被阻断工具测试专注时段。本文未执行工作日测试。

sections.en:
Annual USD totals are Solo Focus $84 ($7 monthly equivalent), Solo+ $144 ($12), Team Focus $120 per user ($10) and Team+ $192 ($16). Monthly counterparts are $9/$15/$12/$18. Confirm tax, member quantity and the selected period. The plus bundles combine Timesheets with Focus; do not assume the lower Focus-only price includes client-project allocation.

The homepage says new users receive a two-week trial and are charged afterward. Confirm cancellation and payment timing rather than interpreting “try free” as a sustained free plan.
sections.zh:
USD 年付总额为 Solo Focus $84（月均 $7）、Solo+ $144（$12）、Team Focus 每用户 $120（$10）、Team+ $192（$16）；月付分别 $9/$15/$12/$18。需确认税费、成员数及周期。加号组合将 Timesheets 与 Focus 结合，不能默认较低 Focus 单价包含客户项目分配。

首页表示新用户有两周试用，之后收费，应确认取消及扣款时机，不能把“免费试用”理解为长期免费。

sections.en:
Personal knowledge workers or teams can evaluate focus and project-allocation goals separately. Establish team visibility and consent before deploying background activity tracking. Investigate pauses, permissions and offline work before treating missing activity as missing work.

No blocking, classification, privacy enforcement, data export, software licence, self-hosted distribution or recovery was verified. Vendor privacy statements describe policy; they are not an independent technical audit or productivity result.
sections.zh:
个人知识工作者或团队可分别评估专注和项目分配目标。部署后台活动追踪前应明确团队可见性及同意，把活动缺失视为未工作前应调查暂停、权限及线下工作。

未核实阻断、分类、隐私执行、导出、软件许可、自托管发行版或恢复。厂商隐私陈述描述政策，不是独立技术审计或生产力结果。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: No activity capture, blocking, billing, team permissions, export, licence or restore test performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试活动采集、阻断、计费、团队权限、导出、许可或恢复。
